en.topic_title: How a housing safety disaster was averted, four decades before the Tai Po fire tragedy
en.topic_summary:
According to the Wang Fuk Court fire inquiry, residents of the doomed estate made no fewer than 180 efforts to ward off the danger presented by careless building work. They sent complaints or inquiries to at least five government departments.



Hongkongers pay tribute to victims who died in the fatal fire in Tai Po Wang Fuk Court. Photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. 



This was not a success. We must note in particular the Labour Department’s achievement. During 15 site visits, their inspectors concluded
